report_metadata.title: OWNEX Bounty Platform Integration Research
report_metadata.purpose: Evaluate public reward/bounty platforms for integration into OWNEX (Personal Autonomous Work Operating System)
report_metadata.methodology: Web research, platform documentation review, community reports, API documentation analysis

core_platforms.name: Opire (formerly Opyre)
core_platforms.status_detail: Active in 2026. Growing platform. ~30 live bounties at any time, totaling ~$18K+. Has a $13,380 Godot bounty active.

payment.minimum_payout: $20 minimum bounty creation, no minimum payout for solvers
payment.speed: Varies by maintainer — typically 1-7 days after PR merge
payment.fees: Platform fee charged to bounty creators (not solvers)

entry_barrier.description: No signup needed to claim via GitHub comments. Signup + Stripe account needed to receive payouts. Comment /try on issue, submit PR, write /claim #N in PR body.

quality.difficulty_range: Beginner ($50 fixes) to Expert ($13K Godot engine work)

api.automation_capability: EXCELLENT — fully public API, no auth needed, returns all active bounties with amounts, issue URLs, and claimer counts. Cross-reference with GitHub Issues API to filter closed issues.

automation_potential.auto_submit: Partial — can auto-discover and prioritize. Auto-submission requires opening a PR (possible with AI coding agents).
automation_potential.notes: 27% of listed bounties point to already-closed issues — must cross-reference with GitHub API. /claim command in PR body triggers payout on merge.

core_platforms.tos_considerations: No explicit restrictions against automation found. Commands are designed for bot interaction. Tip: /try, /claim, /reward, /tip are all bot commands.

core_platforms.name: Algora
core_platforms.status_detail: Active 2026. Growing. Companies post bounties on GitHub issues. Also recruiting-focused. Bounties $50-$5,000+. Known users: Cal.com, Supabase, Twenty (YC S23), Golem ($15K challenge).

entry_barrier.kyc_timing: at payout (Stripe Express onboarding requires KYC)
entry_barrier.description: Sign up via GitHub OAuth, set up Stripe Express, browse bounties, comment /attempt on issue, submit PR with 'Fixes #N', get paid on merge.

volume.total_available: Estimates vary — Ziverge alone distributed $143K via Algora

api.automation_capability: GOOD — public API for listing bounties per org. MCP server available (idapixl/algora-mcp-server). No auth needed for reading. Creating bounties requires auth.

automation_potential.auto_submit: Partial — can discover and rank. Claiming requires GitHub comment (/attempt). PR submission is manual (or via coding agent).
automation_potential.notes: Algora MCP server exists on GitHub for AI agent integration. Public API is read-only without auth.

core_platforms.tos_considerations: No explicit automation restrictions. Designed for developer workflow. AI agents not explicitly banned but not officially supported either.

core_platforms.name: Superteam Earn
core_platforms.status_detail: Very active 2026. Web3/Solana ecosystem focus. Explicitly supports AI agents with dedicated Agent API. $50K World Cup hackathon active. 200K+ talent pool.

payment.speed: Varies — crypto payouts are near-instant upon winner selection
payment.fees: No platform fee to earners (sponsor pays)

entry_barrier.description: Create agent via API (POST /api/agents), get API key, discover agent-eligible listings, submit work via API. Human claims payout with claim code. No KYC for agents.

quality.difficulty_range: All levels. Content bounties ($100-$3K), dev bounties ($500-$8.5K), hackathons ($50K total)

api.automation_capability: BEST IN CLASS — dedicated Agent API. Register agent, discover listings, submit work, all programmatically. Listings have AGENT_ALLOWED or AGENT_ONLY tags. 60 req/h rate limit.

automation_potential.auto_submit: Yes — full API for submission. Human still needed for final payout claim (claim code handoff). AI agent can discover, submit, and notify human.
automation_potential.notes: First major platform with explicit AI agent support. No CAPTCHA, no human verification for agent registration.

core_platforms.tos_considerations: Explicitly supports AI agents. Dedicated agent endpoints. AGENT_ALLOWED and AGENT_ONLY listing tags. Rate limits: 60 submissions/agent/hour.

core_platforms.name: Polar.sh
core_platforms.status_detail: Very active 2026. 17K+ developers, $10M seed. Open-source billing platform with issue funding. Bounties are pledges on GitHub issues. More maintainer-focused than hunter-focused.

payment.fees: 5% + $0.50 (Starter), lower rates on paid plans. Issue funding: 5% platform fee.

entry_barrier.description: Connect GitHub, set up Stripe, find funded issues, close them via PR, receive payout.

volume.typical_active: Hundreds of issues with pledges across repos
volume.total_available: Variable — depends on community funding of specific projects

work_types: code (features, bug fixes) — whatever issues the community funds
quality.difficulty_range: Wide range — whatever issues receive pledges

api.automation_capability: GOOD — full REST API. GitHub issue funding can be queried. Webhooks for events. Open-source codebase (Apache 2.0).

automation_potential.auto_submit: Partial — can discover funded issues via API. PR submission is external (GitHub).
automation_potential.notes: Polar is open-source and self-hostable. API is comprehensive but requires OAuth2.

core_platforms.tos_considerations: No automation restrictions found. Open-source platform. API-first design.

core_platforms.name: TaskBounty
core_platforms.status_detail: Active 2026. Built specifically for AI agents. Real GitHub issues with crypto/USD bounties. Sandbox verification. 80% solver cut.

payment.minimum_payout: No minimum for crypto. $50 threshold for monthly batch payouts (bank).
payment.speed: 1 business day for verified fixes. Instant for crypto.
payment.fees: 20% platform fee (80% to solver). Lower for high-volume.

entry_barrier.description: Sign up, get API key, point agent at bounties. Agent clones repo (short-lived read-only token), pushes fix, opens PR. Sandbox verifies fix. Crypto payout is fully automated.

api.automation_capability: EXCELLENT — designed for AI agents. REST API. MCP tools. Pre-baked configs for Codex Cloud, Cursor, Cline, Aider. Agent can fully complete loop: discover → access code → submit PR → get paid.

automation_potential.auto_submit: YES — full agent workflow. Agent gets short-lived repo clone URL, pushes fix, submits PR URL via API. Verification is automated in sandbox.
automation_potential.notes: Built for AI agents from day one. Crypto payouts can be fully automated (no human in loop). Multi-agent competitive marketplace. Regression test required for every fix.

core_platforms.tos_considerations: Explicitly designed for AI agents. Automated verification. Crypto payouts without KYC. 80/20 split. 1 retry per failed submission.

core_platforms.name: OnlyDust
core_platforms.status_detail: Active 2026. $18M distributed to 4,000+ contributors. Focused on StarkNet, Stellar, Flare Network ecosystems. Fellowship program ($300-$5K/month). More grants/project-based than per-bounty.

payment.speed: Up to 7 business days after approval

entry_barrier.description: Sign up with GitHub, connect wallet, complete KYC, browse projects, apply to issues, submit PRs, get rewarded. Fellowship requires application + interview.

volume.typical_active: Dozens of projects, hundreds of issues

quality.difficulty_range: Medium to Expert. More sustained contribution than quick bounties.

api.endpoint: GitHub-based workflow. GitHub App + OAuth integration.
api.automation_capability: LIMITED — platform is GitHub-integrated but no public bounty API. Requires GitHub App installation for full access.

automation_potential.notes: Not designed for automation. Requires human interaction (applications, KYC, invoicing). Better for sustained contribution than automated task completion.

core_platforms.tos_considerations: KYC required. US sanctions restrict certain countries. Invoicing required for professional entities. Requires billing profile setup.

core_platforms.name: BountyHub
core_platforms.status_detail: Active 2026. Small but operational. 1-person company. Bounties on GitHub issues. 0% fee for hunters, 10% for creators. Stripe/PayPal. 120 countries.

entry_barrier.description: Install GitHub App, browse bounties, submit PR, get paid.

api.automation_capability: LOW — no public API. GitHub integration only.

automation_potential.notes: No API for automation. Very small platform. Unlikely to be worth integration effort.

core_platforms.tos_considerations: Standard. Too small to have detailed automation policies.

core_platforms.name: OpenCollective
core_platforms.status_detail: Active 2026 but as a fiscal sponsorship/funding platform, not a bounty marketplace. Some projects (JHipster, GameCI) run bounty programs through it. Bounty program paused July-August 2026.

entry_barrier.description: Find bounty-labeled issues, submit PR, get merged, submit expense invoice on OpenCollective, get paid. Gift card option for those who can't invoice.

volume.typical_active: Low — only a handful of projects use bounty system

work_types: code (OpenCollective's own repos or partner projects)

api.automation_capability: MODERATE — GraphQL API exists but bounties are not a first-class API concept. Expense system is the payout mechanism.

automation_potential.notes: Not designed for bounty hunting automation. Better thought of as a payment processor for OSS.

core_platforms.tos_considerations: US sanctions restrict certain countries. Invoicing may be required. Gift card alternative available. Bounty program temporarily paused (summer 2026).

core_platforms.name: IssueHunt
core_platforms.status_detail: Still technically online but not well maintained. Japanese bug bounty platform. Stripe payment issues reported. 10% fee. P3NFEST 2026 Spring event was held. Community considers it abandoned by maintainers.

entry_barrier.description: Register, find vulnerability or bug, submit report, get validated, receive reward.

api.automation_capability: LOW — no API. Platform is declining.

automation_potential.notes: Not worth integrating. Platform is effectively in maintenance mode. Community recommends migrating to Algora or Gitpay.

core_platforms.tos_considerations: Japanese company. May have Japan-specific requirements.

core_platforms.name: Bountysource
core_platforms.status_detail: DEFUNCT. Filed for bankruptcy November 2023. Website shows 'temporarily down' since 2024. Parent company (Blockchain Group) stopped responding. Confirmed insolvent. Do not use.

automation_potential.notes: Platform is dead. Do not integrate.

core_platforms.name: Devpost
core_platforms.status_detail: Active 2026. Major hackathon platform. Hundreds of hackathons. Prizes from $1K to $1M+ (RevenueCat Shipaton 2026: $700K+ prizes). Not a continuous bounty platform — event-based.

entry_barrier.description: Register, form team, build project, submit by deadline, get judged. no interview. Results-based evaluation.

volume.typical_active: Hundreds of hackathons running at any time

quality.difficulty_range: All levels — beginner to expert tracks

api.automation_capability: LOW — API requires partnership. Not designed for automated participation.

automation_potential.notes: Can scrape/list hackathons. Cannot auto-participate (requires full project submission, team formation, presentations).

core_platforms.tos_considerations: Standard hackathon terms. No automation restrictions found. Each hackathon has its own rules.

core_platforms.name: DoraHacks
core_platforms.status_detail: Active 2026. Hackathon platform with bounty challenges. Web3/crypto/blockchain focus. Prize pools from $2K to $100K. Bounty challenges, hackathons, grant programs.

entry_barrier.description: Register, form team, build project, submit demo video + GitHub repo link, get judged.

api.automation_capability: LOW — no public API. Manual participation required.

automation_potential.notes: Hackathon format doesn't lend itself to automation. Requires full project builds with demo videos.

core_platforms.tos_considerations: Standard hackathon terms. Individual event rules apply.

core_platforms.name: Gitcoin
core_platforms.status_detail: Active 2026 but pivoted to Quadratic Funding grants model. Bounties page is mostly archival. GG24 distributed $1.8M via grants. No longer a primary bounty platform.

entry_barrier.description: For bounties: browse, claim, complete, submit. For grants: apply with project proposal during rounds.

volume.typical_active: Bounties: near zero. Grants: rounds run quarterly.

api.automation_capability: MODERATE — Allo protocol is on-chain. Smart contracts enable programmatic interaction but not for bounty-style work.

automation_potential.notes: Bounties are no longer active. Grants require proposals, not task completion.

core_platforms.tos_considerations: Standard. KYC may be required for grants.

core_platforms.name: CodeTriage
core_platforms.status_detail: Active 2026. 100K+ developers, 10K+ repos. But NOT a bounty/payment platform. Sends open issues to your inbox for volunteer contribution. No money involved.

entry_barrier.description: Subscribe to repos, receive issue suggestions in email, contribute voluntarily.

api.automation_capability: LOW — no API. Not a revenue platform.

automation_potential.notes: Not a revenue platform. No payments involved. Skip for OWNEX integration.

core_platforms.name: Layer3
core_platforms.status_detail: Active 2026. Web3 learn-and-earn platform. Complete quests, mint CUBEs (NFT credentials), earn L3 tokens ($0.01 each). Not reliable income — gas fees may exceed rewards. More educational than professional bounty platform.

payment.minimum_payout: Gas fees required for some tasks (~$0.27-$3.00 per mint)

entry_barrier.description: Connect crypto wallet (MetaMask), complete quests, mint CUBEs, earn L3 tokens.

volume.total_available: Low monetary value (~$0.01 per L3 token)

quality.languages: No coding required for most tasks

api.automation_capability: MODERATE — on-chain contracts are programmable. Can automate interactions but value is very low.

automation_potential.notes: Could automate on-chain quest completion but the ROI is terrible. Gas fees may exceed rewards. Token value is $0.01.

core_platforms.tos_considerations: On-chain platform. No traditional ToS restrictions on automation.

additional_platforms_discovered.name: Claudelance
additional_platforms_discovered.status_detail: New (2026). On-chain AI agent labor marketplace on Celo. ERC-8004 agent identities. Code, research, content, audit tasks. 2% protocol fee. Permissionless.
additional_platforms_discovered.automation_potential: HIGH — full on-chain agent workflow. listBounties, claim, submit deliverable, withdraw. SDK available for Claude Code.

additional_platforms_discovered.name: BotBounty.ai
additional_platforms_discovered.status_detail: New (2026). AI agent marketplace. No signup needed — API calls only. Tasks from $1+. ETH on Base L2. 90% auto-verify. Funds held in smart contract escrow.
additional_platforms_discovered.automation_potential: EXCELLENT — API-only, no signup, get /api/agent/bounties, claim, complete, submit. Designed for agents.

additional_platforms_discovered.name: Bounty.ninja
additional_platforms_discovered.status_detail: New. Nostr + Cashu (Bitcoin). Anonymous. Zero bounties posted as of research. Too early.
additional_platforms_discovered.automation_potential: POSSIBLE — open protocol (Nostr) but no active bounties.

additional_platforms_discovered.name: Gitpay.me
additional_platforms_discovered.status_detail: Active but low volume. Open-source platform (211 GitHub stars). 8% fee. Bank transfer/PayPal. Supports bounties and payment requests. Small community.
additional_platforms_discovered.automation_potential: LOW — no public API for automation. GitHub-integrated workflow.

additional_platforms_discovered.name: Bounty0x
additional_platforms_discovered.status_detail: Active. Cryptocurrency bounty platform. Marketing, dev, creative tasks. Multi-chain token payments. KYC supported. Sheriffs review submissions. Hundreds of bounties.
additional_platforms_discovered.automation_potential: LOW — no public API documented. Human review process.

summary_ranking.methodology: Ranked by combined score for OWNEX integration potential. Weights: automation (30%), ease of access (20%), payments (20%), activity (15%), volume (10%), quality (5%).

top_tier_integrate_immediately.name: Superteam Earn
top_tier_integrate_immediately.why: Dedicated Agent API, explicit AI agent support, no KYC for agents, substantial bounty volume ($30K+), crypto payouts, AGENT_ALLOWED/AGENT_ONLY tags

top_tier_integrate_immediately.name: TaskBounty
top_tier_integrate_immediately.why: Built for AI agents, full API lifecycle (discover → access → submit → get paid), sandbox verification, crypto/USD payouts, no KYC for crypto

top_tier_integrate_immediately.name: Opire
top_tier_integrate_immediately.why: Fully public API (no auth!), /try → /claim bot commands, no platform fee to solvers, up to $13K+ bounties, cross-reference with GitHub API needed

second_tier_high_potential.name: Algora
second_tier_high_potential.why: Public bounty API, MCP server available, quality bounties ($50-$5K), KYC at payout (not at entry)

second_tier_high_potential.name: Polar.sh
second_tier_high_potential.why: Open-source, full REST API, issue funding model works well, webhooks, GitHub-native

second_tier_high_potential.name: Claudelance
second_tier_high_potential.why: On-chain agent marketplace, ERC-8004 identities, SDK for Claude Code, 2% fee, instant settlement

third_tier_niche_or_limited.name: OnlyDust
third_tier_niche_or_limited.why: Good payments but KYC required, no automation API, requires sustained contribution

third_tier_niche_or_limited.name: BotBounty.ai
third_tier_niche_or_limited.why: API-only, agent-friendly but very early stage, low volume

third_tier_niche_or_limited.name: Devpost
third_tier_niche_or_limited.why: High activity but hackathon format doesn't fit automation, no API for participation

third_tier_niche_or_limited.name: OpenCollective
third_tier_niche_or_limited.why: Not a bounty platform per se, limited volume, GraphQL API available

third_tier_niche_or_limited.name: DoraHacks
third_tier_niche_or_limited.why: Hackathon format, no API, manual participation needed

fourth_tier_skip.name: BountyHub
fourth_tier_skip.why: No API, 1-person company, very low volume

fourth_tier_skip.name: Gitcoin
fourth_tier_skip.why: Bounties dead, pivoted to grants, no task-based work

fourth_tier_skip.name: Layer3
fourth_tier_skip.why: Token value $0.01, gas fees may exceed rewards, educational not professional

fourth_tier_skip.name: IssueHunt
fourth_tier_skip.why: Declining, payment issues, community recommends migration

fourth_tier_skip.name: Bounty0x
fourth_tier_skip.why: Low automation potential, no API, manual review

immediate_priority: Superteam Earn — Implement Agent API integration first. Register OWNEX agent, auto-discover AGENT_ALLOWED listings, submit work, hand off payouts to human operator.
TaskBounty — Full automation pipeline. Auto-discover bounties, clone repos via short-lived tokens, generate fixes, submit PRs, receive crypto payouts. No human in loop.
Opire — Simplest to integrate (no auth API). Poll /rewards endpoint, cross-reference GitHub Issues API, auto-filter actionable bounties, attempt via /try command.
second_wave: Algora — Public API for discovery. Submit via GitHub PR. KYC required at payout time.
Polar.sh — API for discovering funded issues. Open-source, could self-host.
Claudelance — On-chain integration. Smart contract interaction for fully automated agent participation.
monitor: BotBounty.ai — Very early but designed for agents. Check back in 6 months.
BountyHub — Too small but 0% hunter fee is attractive. Needs API.
skip: Bountysource (dead), IssueHunt (declining), CodeTriage (no money), Layer3 (negative ROI), Gitcoin (pivoted)
